content: Sentiment Classifier for Irony: We first implement a one-layer LSTM network to classify ironic sentences in our dataset into positive and negative ironies. The LSTM network is trained with the dataset of Semeval 2015 Task 11 BIBREF0 which is used for the sentiment analysis of figurative language in twitter. Then, we use the positive ironies and negative ironies to train the CNN sentiment classifier for irony.
